home_scanning.intro_description: Photograph four rooms of your home. The app checks each photo for fall, fire and electrical hazards, then tells you what to fix before you exercise.
home_scanning.save_failed: The image could not be saved.
hs.disclaimer: This is a screening aid. It is not a substitute for an occupational therapist's home assessment.
hs.local_note: Photos stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
hs.memory_note: This browser cannot store photos, so they are kept only until you close the page.
hs.hero: Make your home safe to move in
hs.how.title: How it works
hs.how.s1d: Bedroom, kitchen, dining and living room. The app shows you where to stand.
hs.how.s2d: On-device AI looks for trip, fire and electrical risks and rates each one.
hs.how.s3d: Follow the suggested fixes, confirm the results and get your exercise clearance.
hs.tap_people: Tap the residents to say hello.
hs.house_alt: Illustration of a two-storey home with a bedroom, kitchen, living room and dining room.
hs.say.mei: I moved my rugs off the walkway last week. Much safer!
hs.say.ravi: A night light by my bed helps me get to the toilet safely.
hs.say.nurse_tap: Hello! I will guide you through each room.
hs.say.nurse_welcome: Hello, I am Nurse Aisha. Let's check your home together before you start exercising. It takes about 15 minutes.
hs.say.nurse_back: Welcome back! Your home scan is {pct}% done. Let's continue.
hs.say.nurse_map: Choose a room to scan. Each room has a few photos to take. You can use the camera or upload photos from your gallery.
hs.say.nurse_room: Take {n} more required photos in this room. The plan beside each photo shows where to stand.
hs.say.nurse_tut: Good photos give accurate results. Here are eight quick tips.
hs.say.nurse_found: I found {n} things to look at. Check each one: tap Correct or Not a hazard.
hs.say.nurse_clear: This photo looks clear. Well done! Let's move on.
hs.map.tap_room: Tap a room in the house, or choose from the list.
hs.room.all_done: All required photos for this room are done. You can add bonus photos or go back to the house.
hs.room.upload_all_d: Already have photos of this room? Select several at once. They are assigned to the missing photos in order.
hs.exercise_locked: Locked. Scan all four rooms to unlock your exercise clearance.
hs.exercise_open: Unlocked. You are cleared to exercise.
hs.shot.bedroom_bedside: From beside the bed, looking back to the door
hs.shot.kitchen_stove: Facing the stove and cooking area
hs.shot.kitchen_sink: Facing the sink and wet area
hs.shot.dining_far: From the far side of the table
hs.shot.living_exercise: Exercise Zone: stand back to show a clear 2 m x 2 m floor
hs.inc.bedroom_door: the whole bed, floor on both sides, the path to the door and the light switch.
hs.inc.bedroom_bedside: the night-time path to the door, the bedside table, rugs and cables near the bed.
hs.inc.bedroom_corner: the wardrobe base, the floor and any rugs.
hs.inc.kitchen_entrance: the full floor, upper cabinets and any stool or ladder.
hs.inc.kitchen_stove: the stove and what is around it, such as curtains and towels.
hs.inc.kitchen_sink: the sink, nearby sockets and any floor mat.
hs.inc.dining_entrance: the table, all chairs, the floor around the table and the walkway to the kitchen.
hs.inc.dining_far: chair spacing, the overhead light and any cables.
hs.inc.living_entrance: the sofa, coffee table, rugs, TV area and cables, and walkways.
hs.inc.living_sofa: windows, any fan or heater, and walkways.
hs.inc.living_exercise: a clear floor area of at least 2 m x 2 m.
hs.rule.lights: Turn on all the main lights and open the curtains. Do not point the camera at a bright window.
hs.rule.people: Ask people and pets to leave the picture. This protects privacy and lets the app see the floor.
hs.rule.dont_tidy: Do not tidy up first. Photograph the room as it normally is, so the check reflects real risk.
hs.rule.height: Hold the device at chest height (about 1.2 to 1.5 m), tilted slightly down, so the floor fills at least one third of the picture.
hs.rule.landscape: Turn the device sideways (landscape) for room photos. Use portrait only for tall items like shelves.
hs.rule.hold_still: Hold still for 2 seconds until all three READY lights turn green. The shutter button then lights up.
hs.rule.no_flash: Switch the flash off. It causes glare that can look like a wet floor.
hs.rule.all_shots: Take every required photo. Bonus detail photos earn extra points.
hs.tut.title.dont_tidy: Show the room as it is
hs.tut.avoid.people: Faces or pets in the picture
hs.tut.do.dont_tidy: Everyday layout, items where they usually are
hs.tut.avoid.dont_tidy: Moving things just for the photo
hs.tut.avoid.height: Pointing at the ceiling or only at the floor
hs.tut.do.hold_still: Two seconds, both hands, elbows in
hs.tut.do.all_shots: All required photos in every room
hs.cam.review: Check the photo. Is the floor clear to see?
hs.cam.rotate: Tip: turn the device sideways for room photos.
hs.cam.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow the camera in your browser settings and tap Retry, or upload a photo from your gallery.
hs.cam.none: No camera was found on this device. Upload a photo from your gallery instead.
hs.q.too_dark: Too dark. Turn on the lights or open the curtains.
hs.q.too_bright: Too bright. Do not point at a window.
hs.q.blurry: The picture is blurry. Hold still.
hs.q.tilt_roll: Level the device. Do not tilt it sideways.
hs.q.tilt_down: Tilt the device down a little to show the floor.
hs.q.tilt_up: Tilt the device up a little.
hs.q.people: Please ask people to leave the room.
hs.an.title: Safety check
hs.an.photo_alt: Checked photo: {shot}, with detected objects outlined
hs.an.loading_model: Loading the AI model. This happens only the first time...
hs.an.done: {n} objects found in {ms} ms, on this device.
hs.an.none: No hazards found in this photo
hs.an.summary_none: No findings yet. Take or upload a photo to start.
hs.an.estimate: Positions and distances are estimates from a single photo.
hs.an.cv_unavailable: The AI model could not load (check the internet connection). Lighting was still checked. You can retry later.
hs.settings.clear: Delete all photos on this device
hs.settings.clear_confirm: Delete all photos and results on this device? This cannot be undone.
hs.settings.cleared: All photos and results were deleted.
hs.clearance.title: Exercise clearance
